Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous way to identify an organisation.

LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: Legal entity identification as an alternate identification for a party.

ProcessingDate.name: Processing Date
ProcessingDate.definition: Date/time at which the instruction was processed by the specified party.

ProcessingIdentification.name: Processing Identification
ProcessingIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction for the party identified.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Provides additional information to a party identification.
